parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of target instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain target instance ID.

parameters.name: ConfigureName
parameters.description:
<props="china">The name of the configuration item to modify. You can call the [ListInstanceServiceConfigurations](~~201980~~) operation to query the configuration item name.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the configuration item to modify.</props>

> If you want to modify multiple configuration items, specify the Parameters parameter.

parameters.name: ConfigureValue
parameters.description:
<props="china">The value of the configuration item to modify. You can call the [ListInstanceServiceConfigurations](~~201980~~) operation to query the configuration item value.</props>
<props="intl">The value of the configuration item to modify.</props>

> If you want to modify multiple configuration items, specify the Parameters parameter.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The JSON-formatted parameters for modifying multiple configuration items. The key specifies the name of the configuration item, and the value specifies the value of the configuration item.

parameters.name: Restart
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to restart the instance after the configuration is modified. Valid values:

- **true**: Restart the instance.
- **false**: Do not restart the instance.
